method: Reviewed sampled target text and supplied context before reading judge decisions. Rubric shared with judge; judgments made separately.

cases.rationale: A reference link to the MCPB specification and architecture overview serves a different purpose from a submission-type bullet defining eligible desktop extensions.
Automatic propagation of server and plugin updates is distinct from the introduction to remote tool actions and their security consequences.

Connector directory labels and plugin review describe different catalog objects. Each passage preserves its applicable review and trust information; the connector passage also distinguishes discoverability from tool capabilities.
Microsoft delegated permissions and administrator-controlled writes are distinct from Slack plan eligibility and app approval.
The Microsoft connector action list describes Outlook and SharePoint capabilities. The Office-agent passage describes where connectors and skills are enabled across applications.
An endpoint change causing an existing connection to appear as Custom is distinct from explaining that a connector URL can be added without a directory listing.
The troubleshooting passage explains a missing ui.domain value and its remedies. The MCPB comparison explains local versus remote architecture to guide a build choice.
Editable directory listing metadata and accuracy requirements for callable tool descriptions concern different objects and reader tasks.
